result.description: A fictional ultra-wide display designed for immersive simulation rooms, collaborative visual planning, and media wall installations. It combines a 34-inch curved OLED panel with a 21:9 aspect ratio, 3440 x 1440 resolution, 240 Hz refresh rate, and 0.03 ms response time for smooth motion and deep contrast. The stand offers height, tilt, swivel, and pivot adjustment, while the rear housing includes dual HDMI 2.1 ports, one DisplayPort 1.4 input, a USB-C upstream port with 90 W power delivery, and a built-in ambient light sensor. Intended for creative studios and command-center environments, it emphasizes color consistency, wide viewing angles, and quiet fanless operation rather than storage or workstation graphics specialization.
